applies_to: ACS180 drives running the machinery control program, built-in EIA-485 Modbus RTU terminal (embedded fieldbus, EFB), addressing mode 0 (default); firmware manual 3AXD50000467860 Rev D.
summary: ABB's compact ACS180 machinery drive has a built-in EIA-485 terminal on its front that speaks Modbus RTU. The first six holding registers carry the control word, two references, status word and two actual values; every parameter is also a holding register derived from its group and index. This map covers the cyclic block, key 01/04/05 monitoring parameters, the comm-loss settings and the main 32-bit actual values.

addressing.note: The manual uses 6-digit references 400001-465536 for the 65536 holding registers, so 400001 = wire address 0. Masters limited to 5 digits can use 40001-49999 for 400001-409999; 32-bit parameter registers (420000+) need 6-digit or raw addressing. With 58.33 Addressing mode = Mode 0 (default) a 16-bit parameter gg.ii sits at 400000 + 100*gg + ii (e.g. 01.11 -> 400111, wire 110) and a 32-bit copy at 420000 + 200*gg + 2*ii (e.g. 01.07 -> 420214, wire 20213). Mode 1 uses 400000 + 256*gg + ii and Mode 2 uses 400000 + 512*gg + 2*ii; this map assumes Mode 0. 32-bit registers are listed CDAB, which assumes 58.34 Word order = LO-HI, the default.

firmware: ACS180 machinery control program, manual revision D

source.title: ACS180 machinery control program firmware manual
source.pages: PDF pages: parameters 01/04/05 pp. 115-122; group 58 pp. 290-296; Additional parameter data (FbEq32) pp. 333-335, 355-356; EFB connection/setup pp. 384-388; addressing p. 392; control/status words pp. 393-398; start/stop sequence p. 401; holding register table pp. 403-404; error registers pp. 408-409

notes: The EIA-485 port is shared with the external control panel port; jumper J2 must be in 'Modbus Mode' for the EFB to work (J1 sets termination).
Registers 400001-400006 are the factory defaults of Data I/O 1-6 (58.101-58.106) and can be re-pointed; 400007-400014 are user-selectable via 58.107-58.114 and are not listed.
Control and status word bits are shown for the ABB Drives profile (58.25 = 0, default). In this manual 58.25 lists 0 = ABB Drives and 5 = DCU Profile; the DCU words use a different bit layout.

Reference/actual registers are signed 16-bit; 20000 corresponds to the value of 46.01 Speed scaling or 46.02 Frequency scaling (46.03 torque), so their engineering value depends on drive settings and is left unscaled here.
32-bit registers follow 58.34 Word order; the default LO-HI sends the low word first (CDAB). With HI-LO the order becomes ABCD. Within each register the high byte is sent first.

16-bit scaling is the manual's FbEq16 column; 32-bit scaling is the FbEq32 column in the Additional parameter data chapter. Parameters whose 16-bit scaling is 'See par. 46.xx' (01.01, 01.03, 01.06, 01.07, 01.10, 01.14) are listed only in their 32-bit form; the 01.72-01.74 phase currents likewise appear only as 32-bit values (100 = 1 A).

Left out: the error code registers 400090-400095. The heading of that table says 400090-400100 but its reference column numbers the rows 89-94, so the exact register of each row is not stated unambiguously in this manual.
58.16 Communication loss time (default 3.0 s, 0.0-6000.0 s) is left out: its 16-bit scaling is printed only as '1 = 1', so the unit of the integer is unclear.

Left out: 06.xx control/status words, 05.10 control board temperature (unit depends on a setting), 01.50-01.53 hour/day kWh logs and configuration parameters other than the comm-loss settings. Coils and discrete inputs also exist but are omitted.

registers.name: Control word (EFB CW)
registers.description: ABB Drives profile bits shown; DCU profile layout differs (58.25).

bits.0: OFF1_CONTROL: 1 = ready to operate, 0 = ramp stop (OFF1)
bits.1: OFF2_CONTROL: 0 = emergency OFF, coast to stop
bits.4: RAMP_OUT_ZERO: 0 = force ramp output to zero
bits.6: RAMP_IN_ZERO: 0 = force ramp input to zero
bits.10: REMOTE_CMD: 1 = fieldbus control; 0 = last CW/reference kept unless both are 0

integration.summary: Pick the Modbus RTU control macro (or set 58.01 = Modbus RTU and point 20.01 and 22.11/28.11 at the embedded fieldbus), then write the ABB Drives control word and Reference 1 at 400001/400002 and poll the status word and actual values at 400004-400006. Read further monitoring values from their parameter registers (400000 + 100*group + index).
integration.enable: Selecting the Modbus RTU control macro sets 20.01 Ext1 commands = Embedded fieldbus, 22.11 and 28.11 = EFB ref1 and 58.01 = Modbus RTU (and puts fault reset on DI1). Otherwise set them by hand, plus 58.03 node address, 58.04 baud and 58.05 parity, and apply with 58.06 Communication control = Refresh settings.
integration.watchdog: 58.14 Communication loss action (default Fault; also No action / Last speed / Speed ref safe / Fault always / Warning) with 58.16 Communication loss time (default 3.0 s) and 58.15 Communication loss mode (default: only control word/reference writes reset the timer). A loss trips 6681 EFB comm loss or warns A7CE.
quirks: Addresses are 6-digit Modicon references: 400001 = wire 0. 32-bit parameter registers start at 420000 and cannot be reached with 5-digit (4xxxx) addressing.
32-bit values in this map are listed CDAB, which assumes 58.34 Word order = LO-HI (default). If 58.34 is set to HI-LO, read them as ABCD.
References and actual values are signed 16-bit with 20000 = the 46.01/46.02 scaling value, not engineering units.

Start (manual's sequence): write 0x476; when status bit 0 is 1 write 0x477 (ready/stopped), then 0x47F to run. Stop: 0x477 stops per 21.03 Stop mode; 0x47E is an OFF1 ramp stop. Fault reset: rising edge of control-word bit 7.
setup: Defaults: node 1, 19.2 kbit/s, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit (58.03-58.05).
Changes to group 58 take effect only after 58.06 = Refresh settings or a control-unit reboot.
Termination (jumper J1) must be ON at the drives at both ends of the bus.
gotchas: The default comm-loss action is Fault with a 3 s timeout, so a stopped poll trips the drive.
Exception 04h means the drive rejected the request (for example a limit was exceeded).

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
